set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
# R needs a writable TMPDIR/HOME or it dies with "cannot create R_TempDir"
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp

cat > dada.R <<'RSCRIPT'
set.seed(42)
suppressMessages(library(dada2))
# three distinct "ASV" templates (the truth we will require DADA2 to recover exactly)
bases <- c("A","C","G","T")
mk <- function(n) paste(sample(bases, n, replace=TRUE), collapse="")
tmpl <- c(mk(250), mk(250), mk(250))
abund <- c(4000, 2500, 1500)               # reads per template
err <- 0.004                                # per-base substitution rate
# quality must VARY or learnErrors has a single bin and cannot fit the model
lines <- character(0); i <- 0
for (t in seq_along(tmpl)) for (k in seq_len(abund[t])) {
  s <- strsplit(tmpl[t], "")[[1]]
  hit <- which(runif(250) < err)
  if (length(hit)) s[hit] <- sapply(s[hit], function(b) sample(setdiff(bases,b),1))
  q <- pmax(12, pmin(40, round(rnorm(250, mean=36 - (seq_len(250)/250)*8, sd=3))))
  i <- i+1
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf("@r%d", i), paste(s, collapse=""), "+",
             paste(sapply(q, function(x) intToUtf8(x+33)), collapse=""))
}
writeLines(lines, "reads.fastq")
cat("wrote", i, "reads from", length(tmpl), "templates\n")
filterAndTrim("reads.fastq","filt.fastq", truncQ=2, maxN=0, maxEE=2, multithread=FALSE, verbose=FALSE)
e <- learnErrors("filt.fastq", multithread=FALSE, verbose=FALSE)
d <- dada("filt.fastq", err=e, multithread=FALSE, verbose=FALSE)
asv <- getSequences(makeSequenceTable(d))
cat("ASVs inferred:", length(asv), "\n")
cat("exact matches to planted templates:", sum(asv %in% tmpl), "of", length(tmpl), "\n")
cat("spurious ASVs (not planted):", sum(!(asv %in% tmpl)), "\n")
tab <- makeSequenceTable(d)
cat("abundances:", paste(as.integer(tab[1,]), collapse=","), " planted:", paste(abund, collapse=","), "\n")

# ---- assertions: all four are exact-or-wrong, no bands ----
stopifnot(length(asv) == length(tmpl))                       # no over/under-splitting
stopifnot(all(asv %in% tmpl))                                # exact sequence identity
stopifnot(sum(!(asv %in% tmpl)) == 0)                        # no spurious (error-derived) ASVs
got <- as.integer(tab[1, ]); names(got) <- NULL
stopifnot(identical(sort(got), sort(as.integer(abund))))     # every read assigned to its true template
lines <- c("DADA2 -- exact sequence variants recovered from reads with known truth",
  sprintf("dada2_version       %s", as.character(packageVersion("dada2"))),
  sprintf("reads               %d from %d planted templates (250 bp, ~0.4%% substitution)", i, length(tmpl)),
  sprintf("asvs_inferred       %d   (assert == %d, EXACT)", length(asv), length(tmpl)),
  sprintf("exact_seq_matches   %d of %d   (assert all, EXACT string equality)", sum(asv %in% tmpl), length(tmpl)),
  sprintf("spurious_asvs       %d   (assert 0 -- error variants must collapse)", sum(!(asv %in% tmpl))),
  sprintf("abundances_observed %s", paste(sort(got, decreasing=TRUE), collapse=",")),
  sprintf("abundances_planted  %s   (assert identical -- every read placed correctly)", paste(sort(as.integer(abund), decreasing=TRUE), collapse=",")),
  "note  quality scores must VARY or learnErrors has one bin and cannot fit the model")
writeLines(lines, "smoke-check.txt"); cat(paste(lines, collapse="\n"), "\n")
cat("SMOKE CHECK PASSED\n")
RSCRIPT
Rscript dada.R
